fields.name: Geralt of Rivia
fields.description: A mutant witcher who hunts monsters for coin and searches for his adopted daughter, Ciri.

fields.name: Yennefer of Vengerberg
fields.description: A powerful sorceress and Geralt's on-and-off love interest.

fields.name: Ciri
fields.description: Princess of Cintra, bearer of the Elder Blood, Geralt's adopted daughter.

fields.name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
fields.description: An unbeaten demigod warrior afflicted by scarlet rot.

fields.name: Radahn, Starscourge
fields.description: A legendary general famed for stopping time itself in battle.

fields.name: Ranni the Witch
fields.description: A demigod seeking to become the new Elden Lord under a different order.

fields.name: Kratos
fields.description: A former Greek god of war, now living among the Norse gods with his son.

fields.name: Atreus
fields.description: Kratos's son, gradually learning the truth about his own heritage.

fields.name: Freya
fields.description: A Vanir goddess who acts as mentor and ally to Kratos and Atreus.

fields.name: V
fields.description: A Night City mercenary whose mind carries the digital engram of Johnny Silverhand.

fields.name: Johnny Silverhand
fields.description: A rockerboy legend and terrorist who exists as a digital ghost inside V's head.

fields.name: Judy Alvarez
fields.description: A braindance technician and activist from the Moxes gang.

fields.name: Astarion
fields.description: A high elf vampire spawn and former actor hiding a dark past.

fields.name: Shadowheart
fields.description: A secretive cleric of Shar guarding a mysterious artifact.

fields.name: Karlach
fields.description: A tiefling barbarian with an infernal engine in place of a heart.

fields.name: Arthur Morgan
fields.description: Dutch van der Linde's right-hand man, wrestling with a crisis of conscience.

fields.name: Dutch van der Linde
fields.description: The charismatic gang leader whose ideals increasingly clash with reality.

fields.name: Sadie Adler
fields.description: A widowed rancher who becomes one of the gang's most dangerous gunslingers.

fields.name: The Knight
fields.description: A silent bug warrior exploring the ruins of Hallownest.

fields.name: Hornet
fields.description: Protector of Hallownest and the Knight's adoptive sister, wielding needle and thread.

fields.name: Quirrel
fields.description: A friendly wandering bug explorer.

fields.name: Ashen One
fields.description: An undead risen from the grave in search of the Lords of Cinder.

fields.name: Yhorm the Giant
fields.description: A Lord of Cinder who abandoned his throne and his own power.

fields.name: Siegward of Catarina
fields.description: A noble knight sworn to free his friend Yhorm.

fields.name: Michael De Santa
fields.description: A retired bank robber living in comfort and discontent.

fields.name: Trevor Philips
fields.description: An unpredictable and violent arms and drug dealer.

fields.name: Franklin Clinton
fields.description: A young repo man and car thief trying to leave street life behind.

fields.name: Zagreus
fields.description: Immortal prince of the Underworld, repeatedly attempting to escape to the surface.

fields.name: Megaera
fields.description: One of the Furies, and the first serious obstacle on Zagreus's escape attempts.

fields.name: Nyx
fields.description: The primordial embodiment of Night, Zagreus's adoptive mother.
